questions.question: Q starts from Point A and drives 14 km towards the South. He then takes a left turn, drives 10 km, turns left and drives 9 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 7 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 5 km and stops at Point B. Towards which direction should he drive to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees.)
questions.solution:
Given:

Q starts from Point A and drives 14 km towards the South.

He then takes a left turn, drives 10 km, turns left and drives 9 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 7 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 5 km and stops at Point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5a43d3dbf4403ed163a945ae2609721728192c3dc2149439525459ae52558ee.png] 

Thus, Q should drive (10 km - 7 km) 3 km in the west direction to reach Point A again.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
If 'P' stands for '×', 'Q' stands for '÷ ', 'R' stands for '–' and 'S' stands for '+', what will come in place of the question mark '?' in the following equation?

(32 P 4) R (21 P 5) S (9 Q 3) P 6 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: (32 P 4) R (21 P 5) S (9 Q 3) P 6 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 P
 Q
 R
 S
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 ×
 ÷ 
 −
 +
 
 

Now replacing the signs from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ (32 __**×**__ 4) − (21 __**×**__ 5) + (__**9 ÷ 3**__) __**×**__ 6

⇒ 128 − 105 + 3 __**×**__ 6

⇒ 128 − 105 + **__18__**

⇒ __**128 **__− 105 + __**72**__

⇒ **__146 - 105 = 41__**

Hence, the correct option is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

No bike is a car.

All cars are planes.

Conclusions

(I) No plane is a bike.

(II) All planes are cars.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8ea2afdc58b6c207a1b1d5b4b9f993cc16ad26ba6d6f6e630f7a57fa32652f2.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No plane is a bike → Does not follow (As no bike is a car and all cars are planes. As no direct relation is given between plane and bike, therefore it is false.)

(II) All planes are cars → Does not follow (As all cars are planes. So it is possible but not definite

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

Statements:

Some bulbs are sands.

All bulbs are candles.

Conclusion:

(I) Some candles are bulbs.

(II) No candle is a sand.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14369472ab5c57fd612df6793e29b5bc2d485d756d672e2beb2af8f8ef4e6f5f.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some candles are bulbs → **F**ollow (As all bulbs are candles. As whole bulbs comes in candles, therefore it is false.)

(II) No candle is a sand → Does not follow (As some bulbs are sands and all bulbs are candles. As whole bulbs comes in candles and has some part common with sand, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (I) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Seven people, B, C, D, E, F, G and K are sitting in a straight line, facing north. Only five people sit between B and K. G sits to the immediate left of K. Only one person sits between G and E. D sits at some place to the left of F but at some place to the right of C.

Who sits third from the left end of the line?
questions.solution:
Given: Seven people, B, C, D, E, F, G and K are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

1) Only five people sit between B and K.

2) G sits to the immediate left of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/223e030ad50fef2024db640597b509f72b283c87a92c1e094fc1bf38fa92ed34.png]

Thus, according to the final arrangement, D sits third from the left end of the line.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
